content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied because required prior authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission or records would not cure the authorization defect, and similar medical-necessity appeals were paid 0 of 6 times. Because this authorization failure is not a contractual patient-share amount, the balance is not properly billable to the patient and should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
